Convert to a data frame

Source: R/dx_itd.R
as.data.frame.dx_itd.Rd

Convert to a data frame

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dx_itd'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = TRUE,
  variable = NA,
  label = NA,
  measure = NA,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class "dx_itd"

row.names

NULL or a character vector giving the row names for the data frame. Missing values are not allowed.

optional

logical. If TRUE, setting row names and converting column names (to syntactic names: see make.names) is optional.

variable

Variable to include in returned values

label

Labels to include in returned values

measure

Measures to include

...

additional arguments to be passed to or from methods

Value

A data frame with one row per measure, variable, and label, with the estimate, confidence interval, and formatted summary.

Examples

data <- dx_heart_failure
data$predicted[seq(5, 261, by = 20)] <- NA
fit <- dx_itd(data, pred_varname = "predicted", true_varname = "truth")
head(as.data.frame(fit))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 12
